title: Dana Adobe

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Weddings, receptions, and other special events held at the DANA Adobe at Historic Rancho Nipomo have an old-world charm that only early California can offer. Ancient paths wind their way through more than a 130 acre of rolling hills, gardens, an orchard and a vineyard - an historic location perfect for today’s celebration. With both expansive views and small, secluded niches, enjoy the glory of the diverse plants and wildlife just as it was 200 years ago. Guests can be delighted in the shade of the Captain’s Sycamore Tree and the wide canopy of the oaks. blurb: The Dana Adobe at Rancho Nipomo provides a step back in time to early California. Originally part of the lands of the Chumash, Rancho Nipomo became a Mexican Land Grant given to Captain William Goodwin Dana in 1837. Initially Rancho Nipomo was more than 48,000 acres. Today the Dana Adobe and the surrounding property provides visitors with a deeper understanding of California’s history.
